scope: Rebuild existing native UYA octants and group mappings using the current packed scene; shared host planning, mask combination and GPU worker.

algorithm.cameraPositions: Native 4-unit cell center plus eight qualified corners; intersected cells may add four vertical-edge midpoints. Identical positions are shared across cells.
algorithm.qualification: SDK opaque, alpha-aware face checks relocate buried corners locally; inward checks preserve the local side of a wall, guard against crossing another face, and bound extra pull-in toward the center. Reflected TIE/shrub faces preserve authored winding and matching UVs before qualification.
algorithm.views: Six 90-degree cube faces at 1024x1024 per position; LOD0 tie/shrub/tfrag geometry.
algorithm.blocking: Double-sided opaque faces, bilinear texture alpha >=127. Nearby backfaces within 1.5 units allow exit from a clipped wall. Siege variants remain targets but do not block.
algorithm.ocean: PVar ocean heights are two-sided hard visibility barriers, independent of pixel edge allowance.
algorithm.maskAssembly: Union every geometry and moby sample result plus source fallback bits, then compact similar masks conservatively within the source grid allocation. Preserve each cell reserved bit; no neighbor sample feathering or center parallax dilation.
algorithm.execution: Separate hardware WebGPU process, persistent scene resources, stable source ordering, spatial batch culling and bounded submissions/readback.
algorithm.validation: CPU calibration checks, scene hashes, exact raw sample-union validation, compaction subset/reserved-bit checks, native budget and decode/readback before atomic cache replacement. Cancellation preserves the previous cache.

viewportPerformance.source: Saved Outpost masks and 6,331 entity metadata; 143-cell route, 568 measured transitions after warmup
viewportPerformance.limitations: CPU benchmark uses real saved masks and entity metadata with placeholder meshes; GPU render-frame time was not measured.

regressionCoverage: All contributing samples are unioned, including a group visible from one shared corner.
Local wall qualification fixtures for Hoven octants #6267 and #6404.
Alpha, backfaces, ocean boundaries, nonblocking spheres and source depth ownership.
Large-map budgets, malformed input, stale cache, changed project, cancellation and atomic native publication.
Viewport native axes, freeze/reset, manual visibility, selection, picking and incremental normal/mirrored/terrain updates.
remainingWork: Finite samples are not a proof of continuous visibility; vanilla masks are a similarity reference, not pixel ground truth.
Existing fully resolved native mappings and primary terrain are required; custom groups/new octants, streamed terrain and other game adapters remain unsupported.
Cross-vendor, weaker-GPU, Windows and broader emulator/real-hardware route qualification remain open.
Counts are octant/group memberships; group aliases may include objects not visible individually.

cleanup.note: Exploratory harnesses, intermediate reports and large probe outputs remain local ignored artifacts; automated tests use production code and self-contained fixtures.
codeChanges: Separate GPU resource setup, per-view encoding and batch execution into named local functions.
Use the shader bind groups directly instead of patching shader source at runtime; remove the unused collect override, pixel argument and second indirect draw record.
Share camera layout constants and the batch limit between their consumers.
Compile independent raster pipelines concurrently, skip empty moby passes, and copy only active timestamp rows.
Destroy timestamp queries on initialization failure as well as normal completion.
Separate worker result publication from startup/IPC setup and check resource size after reading.
Clarify scene validation phases and sample-union indexing without changing the union rules.
Format GPU code, shaders, host occlusion code and retained tests; replace repetitive obsolete-profile assertions with representative incompatible-profile checks.

verification.hardware: NVIDIA RTX 5090 through the production Electron WebGPU worker
verification.limits: Bounded saved-scene GPU checks; no full-level bake, source project changes or ISO writes.

repeatedTimings.interpretation: Alternating-order short runs show no material general speed change; empty-moby scenes avoid an unnecessary compute pass. These are active-desktop timings, not full-bake performance qualification.

namespaces.RatchetPs2.Core.Occlusion: Host-independent geometry contracts, shared sample planning and corner qualification.
namespaces.RatchetPs2.Games.UYA.Occlusion: Native extraction, mappings, alpha/ocean/Siege policies, calibrated CPU reference, spatial ordering, grids and archive composition.
namespaces.RatchetPs2.Sdk: Game-neutral OcclusionSceneBuilder and OcclusionComposer entry points dispatched by GameId.
namespaces.Forge.Host.Domain.Occlusion: GPU worker protocol, result validation, cache, limits and desktop data contracts.
namespaces.Forge.Host.Games.UYA: Project preparation, SDK orchestration, entity links and publication.
namespaces.Forge Electron/WebGPU/renderer: GPU execution/lifecycle and editor presentation remain in Forge.

changes: Removed the production dependency on the diagnostic probe builder and unused BVH nodes.
Preserved spatial triangle sorting for calibrated raster batches and depth ownership.
Avoided production diagnostic LOD metadata and repeated level analysis.
Moved native composition/readback and Siege classification to the SDK.
Renamed the host service to OcclusionWorkerProtocol and transfer records to OcclusionGpu*.
Moved shared algorithm, ocean and Hoven qualification regressions plus fixtures into SDK tests.

verification.sdkDefaultSuite: Fails the archive replacement/compression assertion in ValidateUyaLevelArchiveBuilder. The same failure was reproduced using saved pre-refactor SDK binaries; targeted occlusion commands pass.

ownershipRefactor.compatibility: Profile, settings, GPU file schema and generated visibility behavior are unchanged. Rebuild Forge and the SDK together after these C# namespace changes.
ownershipRefactor.limits: No full-level GPU rebake or new in-game route test; scene export covers all level41 octants, GPU equivalence uses a matched 242-cell slice, and native roundtrip covers the full grid.

diagnosticsRetirement.removed: Unused SDK diagnostics namespace, experimental BVHs, probes, policy/coverage sweeps, replay harnesses and CLI routes.
diagnosticsRetirement.retained: Production CPU calibration, native read-only corpus analysis, alpha/UV and depth ownership tests, sample qualification, Hoven wall and ocean fixtures, native mask writer tests, editor sample overlays and frozen-octant inspection.
diagnosticsRetirement.productionBakeCode: Unchanged outside removal of the unused Diagnostics namespace.

verification.forgeFullTests: passed (loopback fixtures require network access outside the sandbox)
verification.limits: No full-level GPU rebake; production bake code is unchanged.

maskCompaction.policy: Merge exact masks first, then face-adjacent masks by the total added group bits over their affected octants. Intern duplicate unions immediately; use bounded deterministic candidates for disconnected islands when needed. Stop as soon as the source grid allocation is met.
maskCompaction.ownership: RatchetPs2.Games.UYA.Occlusion through neutral SDK RebuildGrid and CompactGrid entry points; Host coordinates cache publication and viewport loading.
maskCompaction.cacheCompatibility: Compaction is automatic for compatible cached rasters during packing and viewport export. The v21 mirrored-winding correction changes sampling; v20 and v19 masks remain previewable but require a fresh v21 GPU bake before building.
guarantees: Every generated visibility bit is retained.
Octant coordinates and reserved visibility flags are unchanged.
Written grid fits the source grid byte allocation.
Inputs are immutable; cancellation or failure preserves the previous cache.

evaluation.decision: Six face neighbors give nearly the same quality with less work and memory; sorted global and diagonal searches were not integrated.

verification.pythonParity: exact cell masks for both full saved grids
verification.nativeArchiveReadback: passed; all asset bytes outside occlusion unchanged

maskCompaction.referenceComparisonStage: The references section above records pre-compaction raster results. Compacted comparisons are in savedBakes here.
maskCompaction.limitations: Costs count group memberships, not individual objects, triangle cost or measured FPS. No new GPU bake or emulator trap reproduction was performed; the runtime change needs an in-game check.

mirroredRampFix.rootCause: Reflected instance positions reversed triangle winding without updating the bake front/back convention. The qualifier treated the mirrored ramps as an interior air pocket and moved clear upper corners below the floor.
mirroredRampFix.fix: Reverse reflected TIE/shrub B/C positions and their matching UVs during scene extraction. Generic qualifier and pull-in amount remain unchanged.
mirroredRampFix.limits: Bounded saved-scene GPU test; no full-level bake, in-game route test, project writes or ISO changes.
